title: One Shop, Many Products
subtitle: Treat your Etsy shop like a mart: you do not need multiple shops

items.title: Digital
items.text: Planners, templates, printables and coloring books.

items.title: Physical
items.text: Items you make or stock and ship yourself.

items.title: Print on demand
items.text: A partner prints and ships when a buyer orders.

sections.heading: Master prompt: five listing images from one reference image + focus keyword
rows: The product dominant, short title, clean background
Only verified pages or components, short labels
3 to 5 verified features, each tied to a buyer benefit
A real setting; props that do not look included
Purchase, download, use; else "A closer look"

items: 3000 × 3000 px, 1:1 (your request, not an Etsy rule)
Five separate files, never a collage
No fake reviews, discounts or urgency

items.title: Give a listing
items.text: Screenshot, URL and title; ask for a prompt

items.title: One PDF
items.text: Complete the book and list it

columns.title: Do
items: Use competitors only to understand niche and style
Disclose AI use where Etsy asks
Check every page before you sell

columns.title: Never
items: Copy pages, title, wording or characters
Use trademarked characters or brand names

sections.quote: Task: publish at least 10 listings before the next lecture.
sections.text: This is compulsory. Save the listing video prompt in your AI's memory to reuse it.
